Release.Changes:
Version 0.71.6 (beta):
- Enable custom background themes for real. It was locked internal in the previous release.
- Fixed a hang in the SwSh and BDSP shiny detectors if you don't have enough cores. (reported by sirsunspot, credit Gin)
- Fix FRLG Item Dupe and Held Item Farmer for Japanese. (credit dolphincurry)
- SV Egg Autonomous only requires IV judge if checking IVs. (reported by madibye, credit Gin)

Version 0.71.3 (beta):
- Add support for custom background themes. (credit dolphincurry)
- On Windows, video rendering now supports hardware acceleration. (credit denvoros, koi)
- The programs sidebar can now be collapsed. (credit dolphincurry)
- Collapsible sections now use an arrow instead of a checkbox. (credit dolphincurry)
- Discord commands now support string input for keyboard controller.
- Added FRLG Elite Four Battler. (credit thewhitewolfking)
- Added FRLG Egg RNG. (credit Astro)
- TurboA now has different mash speeds. (credit Gin)
- PLZA Overworld Reset now supports preset movement. (credit Gin)
- Fixed a crash in SV Eggs when stopping early. (reported by Zing, credit Gin)
- Improved reliability of SwSh menu detection. (reported by thebeewaspguy, credit jw)
- Improved reliability of FRLG RNG programs. (credit Astro)
- Improved reliability FRLG RNG programs for French. (reported by Antoine, credit Astro)
- Improved reliability of PLZA weather detection. (credit Butters)
- Improved reliability of PLZA dialog detection. (reported by sniper23, credit Gin)
- Improved reliabilty of AutoDA lobby entry. (reported by william052979)
- All firmware updated to latest devkits.
- Fixed an issue where a Pico may incorrectly switch to UART mode due to noise on the UART mode pins.

PrivateBeta.Changes:
Version 0.72.1 (private beta):
- Added Typewriter: A program for entering text into the Switch over the HID-Keyboard controller. We will not say it, but you know what this is for.
- Added FRLG Box Sorter. (credit dolphincurry)
- Added Box Sorter Living Dex. (credit dolphincurry)
- Home Living Dex Sorter: Added living dex templates for some popular online tools. (credit dolphincurry)
- Home Living Dex Sorter: Added custom dex template through integration with RotomLabs. (credit dolphincurry)
- Home Living Dex Sorter: Fixed an issue where the wrong pokemon would be moved to the reject box. (Reported by danielbrodie)
- Improved compatibility with various audio devices.
- Added the ability to give names to your video and audio devices. (credit pif)
- Improved reliability of FRLG Gift RNG. (reported by kuri07405, credit Astro)
- Fixed keyboard settings not being loaded unless Switch settings are loaded. (credit serpulga)
- Fixed incorrect nature logging for SV. (credit serpulga)
- Fixed crash from Discord with flaky internet. (credit dolphincurry)
- Improved reliability of SV AutoStory. (reported by qanthelas, credit jw)
- Improved fault-tolerance of AutoDA. (reported by arosmian)
- Improved reliability of AutoDA. (credit dayfine)
- More AutoDA reliability fixes. (reported by kai0331)
- General program stability. (credit dayfine)
